visual.general_description: Line chart with three curves of lactate (mmol/L) on the vertical axis against time to ECMO initiation (h) on the horizontal axis. Curves labelled Case 1 (dotted), Case 2 (dashed) and Case 3 (solid) all end at the -1 h tick; a boxed downward arrow labelled ECMO is drawn above the 0 tick.
visual.detailed_description: White background with light gray horizontal gridlines at 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 on the vertical axis labelled Lactate (mmol/L). The horizontal axis is labelled Time to ECMO initiation (h) with ticks from -8 to 0. The dotted curve labelled Case 1 rises gradually from about 3 at -7 h to about 8 at -1 h, with a flatter stretch near 7 between about -3 and -2 h. The dashed curve labelled Case 2 rises from about 14 at -8 h to about 20 at -1 h. The solid curve labelled Case 3 starts at about 10 at about -3.5 h, stays flat until about -2.5 h, then rises steeply to about 20 at -1 h. A white box with a dark outline reading ECMO with a downward arrow points to the 0 tick on the horizontal axis. No curve is drawn between -1 h and 0 h. No numeric values are printed beside the curves.
